items.title: SGLang 推出 Weight Cache Daemon，实现亚秒级引擎重启 / Blog Fast Engine Recovery： Sub-Second Engine Restart for SGLang via Weight Cache Daemon Nowadays， State-of-the-Art （SOTA） models are getting much bigger and reloading the model service after a crash is very expensive. cynic.review: 缓存权重省重启时间，思路实在，但别吹成颠覆，先看生产环境扛不扛得住。
